notes.title: Mortisomem - 1.2.1 Patch Notes
notes.content:
-Fixed a bug that caused the signs on the map to not update properly when the player changed the language.

Thank you to all people playing Mortisomem, if you find a bug or another issue with the game, speak to the developer in: https://discord.gg/AygFDaujxC

notes.title: Mortisomem - 1.2.0 Patch Notes
notes.content:
-Fixed several bugs related to the compatibility the controller.

If you encounter any problema, get in touch with the developer in: https://discord.gg/AygFDaujxC

notes.title: Mortisomem 1.1.3 Patch Notes
notes.content:

Remember that you can report bugs here: https://discord.gg/X6ThCjV8WZ
